decisions.reason: The image-count change does not alter the internal-link requirement; the source message's separate internal-link clause is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
Specifying three to four images per article does not change the existing article count, delivery window, or condition that images and internal links be added before publication.
The required number of article images does not change the selected blog keywords.
The image-count instruction does not alter the workflow for suggesting or selecting blog topics.
The blog image-count change is unrelated to campaign keyword quantity, selection, or page mapping.
The article image-count instruction does not change the webpage replacement text.
The number of images required in blog articles does not affect backlink volume or link-type percentages.
Requiring three to four pictures in each blog does not establish or modify any requirement concerning ALT attributes.
